result.stdout:
SmartAdmin Generator

Usage:
  smartadmin <command> [options]

Commands:
  new       Scaffold a SmartAdmin solution from an embedded architecture template.
  generate  Generate CRUD modules from a SQL Server schema.

Examples:
  smartadmin new ./MyAdmin --name MyAdmin
  smartadmin new . --name MyAdmin --architecture clean-architecture
  smartadmin new --list-architectures
  smartadmin generate
  smartadmin generate --tables dbo.Products,dbo.Orders --mode Incremental

Run 'smartadmin <command> --help' for command-specific options.

result.stdout:
SmartAdmin Generator - new

Description:
  Creates a new SmartAdmin solution with a consistent project structure and smartadmin.json.

Usage:
  smartadmin new [path] --name <ProjectName> [options]

Options:
  --name <ProjectName>            Required. Solution name and root namespace.
  --architecture <id>             Template id. Default: clean-architecture.
  --list-architectures            List installed architecture templates.
  --force                         Scaffold into a non-empty directory.

Examples:
  smartadmin new ./MyAdmin --name MyAdmin
  smartadmin new . --name MyAdmin --architecture clean-architecture
  smartadmin new --list-architectures

result.stdout:
SmartAdmin Generator - generate

Description:
  Reads database schema metadata and generates module files into an existing SmartAdmin solution.

Usage:
  smartadmin generate [options]

Options:
  --config <path>      Path to smartadmin.json. Defaults to ./smartadmin.json.
  --output <path>      Output root. Defaults to the current directory or config outputRoot.
  --provider <name>    Database provider. Default: SqlServer.
  --tables <list>      Comma-separated table names to include.
  --exclude <list>     Comma-separated table names to exclude.
  --templates <path>   Template override folder.
  --plugins <list>     Comma-separated plugin assembly paths.
  --mode <mode>        SkipExisting, Incremental, Preview, or Force.
  --force              Overwrite generated files.
  --verbose, -v        Print resolved generation settings.

Examples:
  smartadmin generate
  smartadmin generate --tables dbo.Products,dbo.Orders
  smartadmin generate --exclude dbo.AuditLogs --mode Incremental
  smartadmin generate --templates ./templates --config ./smartadmin.json
